name: Lendlease Global Commercial REIT
summary: Lendlease Global Commercial REIT is established with the principal investment strategy of investing, directly or indirectly, in a diversified portfolio of stabilized income producing real estate assets located globally, which are used primarily for retail and/or office purposes. As at 30 June 2026, its portfolio comprises leasehold properties in Singapore namely Jem, 313 at somerset, PLQ Mall as well as freehold interest in three Grade A commercial buildings in Milan. These properties have a total value of approximately S4.2 billion dollars.
